# Contributing to Codrawithm

Thank you for taking the time to contribute — every bit of feedback, discussion, and design input helps shape this project into something great.

## Where we are right now

Codrawithm is in **early ideation**. The core concepts are forming, the architecture is being sketched out, and foundational decisions are still open. This is the best time to get involved: your ideas can genuinely influence the direction of the project.

For the full contribution guide — including coding standards, branch conventions, and the review process — see:

📖 **[docs/community/contribution-guide.md](../docs/community/contribution-guide.md)**

## 3 quick ways to contribute right now

1. **Join the discussion** — Browse open [GitHub Discussions](../../discussions) and share your thoughts on features, architecture, and direction. No code required.

2. **File or refine an issue** — Found a gap, a contradiction, or something unclear? Open an [issue](../../issues) using one of the templates. Well-described problems are just as valuable as solutions.

3. **Contribute to the design** — Share wireframes, UX feedback, accessibility considerations, or visual ideas. Drop them in a Discussion thread or attach them to a relevant issue.

## Code of Conduct

All contributors are expected to follow our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Please read it before participating.
